title: HasanAbi vs xQc and Asmongold: Hasanabi calls streamers "worm-like" over Charlie Kirk song
summary_full: HasanAbi has fired back at xQc, Asmongold, Destiny and others after they criticized his appearance singing the “We Are Charlie Kirk” song. During an August 23 livestream, Hasan called his critics “worm-like individuals” and “opportunists,” while accusing them of farming outrage and relying on algorithm-driven drama. He also argued that the backlash showed a clear double standard around political jokes and criticism.
